Acme Soda announces the Fizz Fest summer tour

Published 2026-10-20

Acme Soda today announced Fizz Fest, a 20 city music tour that kicks off on December 5, 2026 and runs through March 2027. Fans can buy tickets at every stop and pick up limited merch at the Acme booth.

“Fizz Fest brings our fans together in person,” said Jane Smith, the chief marketing officer of Acme Soda. The tour will visit stadiums and arenas across the United States, with branded signs at every venue.

Tickets go on sale November 20. Acme Soda says it expects more than 500,000 fans to attend across the tour, which is the largest event program in the history of the company.
